commitResults.messageTitle: Rename Duke to LeBron and implement greet/exit behavior
commitResults.messageBody:
Renames the chatbot from Duke to LeBron across the entry-point class
and docs, replaces the old figlet banner with a LeBron block-letter
banner, and updates main() to print a divider-wrapped greeting on
startup followed by a farewell message before exiting.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Fill in student profile in AGENTS.md
commitResults.messageBody:
Records the student's prior programming experience and IDE familiarity
so future assistance is tailored appropriately, and fixes a stray typo
in the top-level heading.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Echo user input and exit on "bye"
commitResults.messageBody:
Adds a read loop that echoes each entered line back to the user,
terminating when the input is "bye", per the required chatbot
command-loop behavior.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Adds a fixed-size String[100] array to remember each item the user
enters, printing "added: ..." on entry and a numbered listing on the
"list" command, per the Level-2 spec (in-memory only, no persistence).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Task class to represent an item with done/not-done status
commitResults.messageBody:
Introduces a Task object bundling a description with an isDone flag,
plus mark()/unmark() and a toString() that renders as "[X] desc" or
"[ ] desc". This replaces the plan of using a parallel boolean array
alongside the existing String[] items, since keeping description and
status together on one object is simpler to reason about and extends
naturally to future task types (todo/deadline/event).

Not yet wired into LeBron.java; that follows in the next commit.

commitResults.messageTitle: Store tasks as Task objects instead of raw strings
commitResults.messageBody:
Swaps the Task[] array in for the old String[] items array so each
stored entry carries its own done/not-done status via Task, not just
its text. addItem() now wraps input in new Task(...); printList()
relies on Task.toString() to render the "[ ] desc" / "[X] desc" line.
List/add behaviour and output are otherwise unchanged.

Adds handling in processCommands() for two new command forms, each
followed by the 1-based index shown by "list". markTask() converts to
a 0-based array index, flips the task's done status via Task.mark()/
unmark(), and echoes the updated task back to the user.

Indices are trusted as valid for now (no bounds/parse-error handling
yet) — that's the next step.

commitResults.messageTitle: Handle invalid task numbers in mark/unmark without crashing
commitResults.messageBody:
markTask() previously trusted its index argument, so a non-numeric
value threw NumberFormatException and an out-of-range value threw
ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException, both of which would have terminated
the program. Now both cases are caught and reported as a normal
chatbot message, and the valid path is unchanged.

commitResults.messageTitle: Make Task abstract and add Todo task type
commitResults.messageBody:
Task now delegates its type icon ([T]/[D]/[E]) to subclasses via an
abstract getTypeIcon() method, laying the groundwork for Deadline and
Event. Todo is the first concrete subclass; the free-text fallback in
LeBron now constructs a Todo instead of a bare Task.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Deadline task type and deadline command
commitResults.messageBody:
Parses "deadline <description> /by <date>", rejecting the command with
a friendly message if the description or the /by date is missing.
addItem is folded into a new storeTask(Task) so both the free-text
fallback and the parsed deadline task share one storage path, and the
acknowledgement now prints the task's full decorated form.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Event task type and event command
commitResults.messageBody:
Parses "event <description> /from <start> /to <end>", rejecting the
command with a friendly message if the description, /from, or /to
part is missing. The /to marker is searched for only after /from so a
missing /from isn't masked by a coincidental match further in the
text.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add explicit todo command and reject unrecognized commands
commitResults.messageBody:
Free text is no longer silently stored as a to-do; it must now start
with "todo ". Anything that isn't list/mark/unmark/bye/todo/deadline/
event is rejected with an error instead of being treated as a task,
consistent with the new typed-command interface.

Introduces a single checked exception type to carry LeBron-flavored,
user-facing error messages, replacing the print-and-return-null
pattern currently duplicated across the parse/mark methods.

parseTodo/parseDeadline/parseEvent now throw LeBronException with
LeBron-flavored messages instead of printing and returning null.
processCommands catches the exception at each of these three call
sites for now; this will be consolidated into a single catch once
markTask is converted too.

commitResults.messageTitle: Throw LeBronException from markTask instead of printing inline
commitResults.messageBody:
Replaces the NumberFormatException catch and the out-of-range if
check with LeBronException throws, matching the pattern used by the
parse methods. Call sites in processCommands each catch it for now;
consolidation into a single catch comes next.

commitResults.messageTitle: Simplify storeTask now that parsing can't return null
commitResults.messageBody:
The parse methods throw LeBronException instead of returning null on
failure, so storeTask can no longer be called with a null task; the
now-unreachable guard is removed.

Wraps the whole command dispatch in a single try/catch(LeBronException),
replacing the per-branch catches added in the previous two commits.
The unrecognized-command branch now throws LeBronException instead of
printing directly, so all user-input errors flow through one place.

commitResults.messageTitle: Switch task storage from array to ArrayList
commitResults.messageBody:
The fixed-size Task[] + itemCount pair required manual bookkeeping
(capacity, index tracking) and would need array-shifting logic to
support removing tasks. Swapping to List<Task> backed by an
ArrayList lets storeTask, printList, and markTask rely on the
Collections API's size()/get()/add() instead, and clears the way
for a delete command that can just call List.remove(index).

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for deleting tasks from the list
commitResults.messageBody:
Adds a "delete <n>" command that removes the given 1-based task and
prints a confirmation, mirroring markTask's parsing/validation
pattern (LeBronException on a non-numeric or out-of-range index).
Relies on List.remove(index) from the ArrayList-backed storage
introduced in the previous commit rather than manual shifting.
